name: AI-Market-Trend-Forecaster
description: An intelligent market forecasting dashboard that moves beyond simple predictions. This tool combines sentiment analysis with technical indicators (RSI & MACD) and uses a unique backtesting engine to select the best predictive model. Final forecasts are presented with full explainability using SHAP for transparent and trustworthy insights.

paragraphs: A sophisticated AI-powered stock market forecasting application that combines historical price data, sentiment analysis of news headlines, and advanced technical indicators to predict future market trends. The application uses machine learning models to provide accurate forecasts with explainable AI insights.
features: Automatic Model Showdown: Tests multiple sentiment window configurations and selects the best-performing model
Multi-Indicator Analysis: Integrates RSI, MACD, and SMA for comprehensive technical analysis
Sentiment Intelligence: Analyzes news headlines using Hugging Face NLP models
Explainable AI (SHAP): Provides transparent insights into model predictions
Interactive Dashboard: Professional Streamlit interface with real-time charts
